0022600090.text: The New Orleans Pelicans host the Indiana Pacers in a game that opens both teams' 2026-27 seasons, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Pelicans a 35% chance to win. Indiana is missing Johnny Furphy, who is out after knee surgery, and Aaron Nesmith, Jarace Walker and T.J. McConnell are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, with Nesmith dealing with a hamstring issue and the reasons for Walker and McConnell undisclosed. The teams split their two 2025-26 meetings, most recently when the Pelicans lost 127-119 in Indianapolis on January 16, 2026.
